# Campus Locations and Recognition Status

## Main Campus

The official Main Campus page identifies the Main Campus as **Charbagh, Swat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan**. It lists academic blocks, teaching departments and administrative offices located at the Main Campus.

Official page: https://uswat.edu.pk/maincampus/

## Women Campus

The University of Swat maintains a Women Campus page. The page states that the Women Campus was inaugurated on **25 July 2017** and describes the College of Home Sciences as a constituent college whose Home Economics department became part of the Women Campus.

The Women Campus page lists these departments:
- Botany
- Psychological Studies
- Zoology
- Home Economics
- Computer and Software Technology
- English and Foreign Languages

The page identifies a Campus Coordinator and provides the email `mahrukhanum@uswat.edu.pk`. It also lists `womencampus@uswat.edu.pk` as a contact email and refers to the Girls Hostel at Main Campus.

Official page: https://uswat.edu.pk/women-campus/

## HEC campus-list caveat

The HEC recognised-campuses page lists **Women Campus Swat** with a validity period shown as **15 January 2024 to 30 September 2025**. Since that displayed end date has passed, this knowledge base does **not** assert that the campus currently holds the same HEC campus recognition status. Users asking about current recognition should be directed to HEC and the university for confirmation.

## Shangla

The University of Swat's historical About page says a Shangla Campus was established. However, the HEC recognised-campuses page states that **Shangla was upgraded to the University of Shangla with effect from 1 August 2022**.

Therefore, do not describe Shangla as a current University of Swat campus. The historical reference should be understood in the context of the later upgrade.

## How the chatbot should answer campus questions

- For the university's currently presented campus information, link to the official Main Campus and Women Campus pages.
- If asked whether Women Campus is currently HEC-recognised, disclose that the HEC page currently displays a validity period ending 30 September 2025 and recommend confirmation from HEC/the university.
- If asked about Shangla, explain that it was historically mentioned as a University of Swat campus and that HEC records its upgrade to the University of Shangla effective 1 August 2022.
- Do not infer current campus operations, admission availability, program offerings or recognition from an old page alone.

- **Fee categories (other than hostel fees):** admission fee, tuition fee, medical fee, examination fee, university registration fee, contributions to specified educational, social and recreational funds, and other fees set from time to time. The university may also charge magazine fee, Students' Welfare Fund fee, identity card fee and others decided by the Syndicate.
- **Who sets fees:** the Syndicate, on the recommendations of the Academic Council and the Finance and Planning Committee.
- **Annual increase:** the Syndicate may make a 10% annual increase in fees and charges, or increase/decrease the rate. An increase applies to **newly admitted students**; already-admitted students continue paying the fee in force at first admission unless the Syndicate decides otherwise in a particular case with written reasons.
- **Refund:** students who cancel or withdraw may be entitled to a tuition fee refund on grounds such as personal emergencies, health reasons, care or medical reasons for family members, legal/immigration matters, delay in admission in other universities, and other cases decided case by case. A student required to leave because entry requirements were not met after results are announced is eligible for a refund. Applications need the prescribed form and proof of payment. The Syndicate may declare any fee non-refundable. A student expelled in disciplinary proceedings gets no refund except the refundable security deposit.
- **Fee adjustment on a second admission:** if a student is admitted to another discipline, program or department within 10 days of the first admission, fees already deposited transfer to the new department; any shortfall is paid and any excess refunded.

## Content of Statutes 2025 that was read (pages 1-64)
- **Applicability and governance:** the Statutes apply to authorities, faculties, departments, directorates, centres, institutes and sub-campuses, and to university employees (except contract, deputation and contingency staff).
- **Service rules:** probation of one year (extendable by one year); retirement on superannuation at 60 years; annual increment on 1 December; right of appeal within 30 days. These concern employees, not students.
- **Fees and miscellaneous charges:** see `01-admissions/fee-structure.md`.
- **Register of Registered Graduates:** the Registrar maintains it through the Controller of Examinations, and a report of the number of registered graduates is published on the university website.
- **Annual Report:** prepared by the university, considered by the Syndicate and submitted to the Senate within three months of the end of the academic year.
- **Teacher recruitment:** vacancies are advertised in at least two nationwide newspapers and on the university website; selection board interview qualifying marks are 60%; teacher scales are BPS-18 Lecturer, BPS-19 Assistant Professor, BPS-20 Associate Professor, BPS-21 Professor, BPS-22 Meritorious Professor; closing date normally 15 to 30 days after advertisement.

title: Source Verification and Status Rules
content:
# Source Verification and Status Rules

This document defines machine-readable statuses used by the knowledge base. A status describes the evidence available at capture; it is not a guarantee that a fact remains current.

## Canonical `verification_status` values

| Value | Meaning | Current-answer handling |
|---|---|---|
| `verified` | The cited source supported the recorded statement at the recorded capture date. | May be used, subject to time-sensitivity and validity checks. |
| `verified_with_caveats` | Evidence supports the statement, but an explicit limitation or qualification applies. | Include the caveat in the answer. |
| `historical` | The record is intentionally retained as historical information. | Use only for historical questions or clearly date it. |
| `potentially_outdated` | The information may have changed since capture or its effective period is unclear. | Do not present as current without re-checking an authoritative source. |
| `unverified` | The claim has not been confirmed by adequate authoritative evidence. | Do not assert as fact; abstain or explain the gap. |
| `not_found` | The information was not located in the collected sources. | Treat as a research gap, not proof that the information does not exist. |
| `documentation` | The file describes project methodology, metadata, or QA rather than university facts. | Exclude from factual answer retrieval unless the user asks about KB methodology. |

Use underscores exactly as shown. Do not use spaces or alternate spellings in machine-readable metadata.

## Date fields

- `accessed_date`: date a source was accessed. It does not mean every statement was independently re-verified that day.
- `last_verified_date`: date the specific factual content was checked against its source. Leave `null` when not known.
- `document_date`: date printed or formally issued on the source, if known. Do not infer from a URL path alone.
- `academic_session`: session to which the record applies, if explicitly stated.
- `valid_from` / `valid_until`: explicit effective dates, not inferred dates.

## Source mapping

`source_keys` must reference keys in `metadata/source-registry.json`. Map keys only when the document's cited URL matches a registry URL or a human reviewer has explicitly confirmed the relationship. Do not assign a plausible-looking source key based only on a filename or topic. A factual document with no confirmed source mapping must be flagged for manual review.

## Source authority

Keep official University of Swat pages and documents distinct from HEC/government records and third-party websites. Third-party sources may help discover information but must not silently override official sources.

## Time-sensitive topics

Admissions, deadlines, fees, scholarships, calendars, jobs, announcements, office holders, contact details, campus recognition and service availability require a current-source check before being presented as current. Historical information may remain retrievable for explicitly historical questions.

# University of Swat Knowledge Base — v2.1

AI-ready Markdown knowledge base for the University of Swat, Pakistan, assembled from the official university website and cited official documents, with HEC and government records kept distinguishable. **Capture/audit date: 2026-11-18. This is a research snapshot, not an exhaustive or live source.**

## What changed in v2.1

- Standardized the machine-readable status `potentially_outdated` and expanded the status definitions.
- Added source-key mappings only where explicit source URLs match the source registry; unresolved mappings remain visible for manual review.
- Added `metadata/chunk-preview.json` with heading-aware, paragraph/table-preserving chunk previews and metadata.
- Added `metadata/rag-evaluation-set.json` with 16 structured evaluation cases, including Urdu, Roman Urdu, privacy boundaries and prompt-injection resistance.
- Updated manifest metadata and declared an initial chunking profile (500-token target, 800-token maximum, 80-token overlap recommendation). Token counts in the preview are approximate and must be replaced with the selected model tokenizer before production ingestion.

## What changed in v2

- Reconciled the campus overview with the separate campus-status file.
- Removed obsolete statements that Main/Women Campus and About-page vision/mission content were unavailable.
- Recorded the HEC-reported Shangla upgrade and the Women Campus recognition-date caveat without asserting current renewal.
- Rewrote the research gaps and corrected the archive counts.
- Added a RAG evaluation test set covering supported answers, partial answers and required abstentions.
- Updated the manifest and introduced explicit temporal/provenance metadata.

## Contents

| Folder | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `00-university-overview` | Profile, history, leadership, vision/mission/values, legal status and campuses |
| `01-admissions` | Admissions contacts, fee snapshot, scholarships and deadline status |
| `02-academics` | Faculties, departments, academic calendar and semester system |
| `03-departments-and-faculty` | Department contact directory |
| `04-student-services` | Public service and portal descriptions |
| `05-administration` | Offices and contact directory |
| `06-research-and-development` | ORIC references |
| `07-policies-and-regulations` | Regulations and policy index |
| `08-news-and-announcements` | Dated news snapshot |
| `09-careers-and-opportunities` | Dated job snapshot |
| `11-downloads-and-official-documents` | Official document inventory and forms |
| `12-contacts-and-faqs` | General contacts and FAQs |
| `13-source-registry` | Sources, verification, research gaps, audit log and RAG tests |
| `metadata` | Manifest, categories, source registry and research summary |

## Start here

1. Read `13-source-registry/research-gaps.md` before using the knowledge base.
2. Read `13-source-registry/source-verification.md` for source and status conventions.
3. Use `metadata/knowledge-base-manifest.json` to enumerate content files and metadata.
4. Use `13-source-registry/rag-evaluation-test-set.md` to test retrieval and abstention.

## Verification and temporal metadata

Existing `verification_status` values are retained. V2 adds or recommends these fields in Markdown front matter and RAG chunk metadata: `last_verified_date`, `valid_from`, `valid_until`, `source_authority`, and `is_time_sensitive`. Missing values must remain null/unknown; do not infer dates.

Status meanings: `verified` means the cited source supported the recorded statement at capture; `verified_with_caveats` means the fact is supported but has an important limitation; `historical` means it should not be presented as current; `potentially outdated` means re-check before current use; `unverified` means not confirmed; `not found` means not located in the collected sources.

## Critical chatbot rules

- Never invent deadlines, fees, eligibility criteria, programmes, contact details or recognition status.
- Treat fees, deadlines, calendars, scholarships, jobs, news, office holders and campus recognition as time-sensitive.
- Distinguish University of Swat from University of Shangla.
- Keep Main Campus (Charbagh) separate from the HEC profile's Odigram contact address.
- The HEC Women Campus entry displays a validity period ending 2025-09-30; current renewal is not confirmed by this archive.
- If the retrieved material does not support an answer, say so and direct the user to the relevant official source.
- Do not ingest credentials, private student records or restricted portal content.

## RAG preparation

1. Parse front matter into chunk metadata.
2. Split Markdown by meaningful headings; keep tables and their captions/headers together.
3. Preserve each chunk's source URLs, file path, heading, status and temporal fields.
4. Filter or down-rank `unverified`, `historical` and `potentially outdated` chunks for current questions. Do not simply delete them if historical questions are supported.
5. Require the answer to cite retrieved sources, state dates for time-sensitive claims and abstain when current evidence is missing.
6. Evaluate with `13-source-registry/rag-evaluation-test-set.md` before deployment.

## Updating the knowledge base

Re-open the source URLs in `metadata/source-registry.json`, compare the new content with the existing record, update the relevant Markdown file and its verification/temporal metadata, regenerate the manifest, and add an entry to the audit changelog. Never change an old fact to a new value without retaining the source context and date.

## v2.1 limitations and manual review

- This update is a structural/RAG-preparation pass over the existing v2 archive; it is not a fresh crawl or re-verification of university sources.
- Source mappings are added only from explicit front-matter URLs that exactly match the source registry. Documents with no confirmed source mapping remain unmapped; do not guess.
- `metadata/chunk-preview.json` is a preview. Validate chunk boundaries, token counts and retrieval quality using the actual embedding model before database ingestion.
- The expanded evaluation set defines expected behaviour; no live retrieval or answer-quality score is claimed.
- Time-sensitive facts (fees, deadlines, calendars, scholarships, jobs, announcements and recognition status) still require current-source verification.
